title: Mephiboseth
summary: Raleigh names Mephiboseth in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Mephiboseth, also printed Mephibosheth, the sonne of Ionathan. He liued and had the right to Israel when Abner aduanced Isboseth, and Dauid spared him when Sauls line was giuen to the Gibeonites. He is not Isboseth. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
